152445.title: Carolina Ferdinanda Louisa of Sicily (1798-1870). Wife of Charles Ferdinand, Duc de Berry, in the Park of Bagatelle in the Bois de Boulogne (near Paris)
152445.creator: François Gérard

editorial.note: François Pascal Simon Gérard (1770 - 1835). Carolina Ferdinanda Louisa of Sicily (1798 - 1870), wife of Charles Ferdinand, duc de Berry, in the park of Bagatelle in the park of Bagatelle in the Bois de Boulogne near Paris.
Petronella Dunois meticulously assembled the dolls’ house displayed here at the right. She commissioned various craftsmen to create each component.
The plums in the basket and the woman’s subtly exposed shoulder imbue the painting with an erotic undertone. The type of hat atop her head was mostly worn by Romani women at the time.
